meta_desc: Lead Software Engineer at Decathlon Digital. Over 10 years of software development, technical leadership and engineering management.
hero_desc: A developer at heart, a leader by experience.
philo_quote: Engineering is more than just code. My approach: understand the why, craft the how.
about_1: A Software Engineer for over 10 years, I've moved between software development, technical leadership, and engineering management. At Decathlon Digital, I've worked on Business Intelligence products and then on the modernization of the global Warehouse Management System (WMS).
about_2: After several years in management, I've chosen to get back to what I enjoy most: writing code, solving technical challenges, and turning ideas into working software. Software architecture, modern development practices, and how AI is changing the way we build products are at the heart of my daily work.
about_3: My time as a manager has given me a broader perspective on engineering, collaboration, and the people behind the technology. What matters most to me? Building useful software, learning every day, working with great people, and enjoying what I do.
stat_4_sub: Dev, Scrum Master, Tech Lead, EM
exp_card1_desc: A humble and attentive manager. My mission is to create a trusting, transparent and caring environment where the team can speak up, grow and deliver value autonomously.
exp_card2_desc: A developer at heart with a strong Backend profile and a global understanding. I design technical solutions balancing a high standard for Code Quality with pragmatism.
exp_card3_desc: Sound engineering starts with precise scoping. I align user needs with technical realities through a blend of hard and soft skills serving the product.
exp_card4_desc: Contributed to the adoption of AI-assisted development practices through experimentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
path_title: Ten years building software — and teams.
job_1_desc: Back to hands-on software engineering, focusing on software development, architecture, and AI. Building useful software, solving real problems, sharing knowledge, and continuously learning.
job_2_place: Lille — Supply / Logistics & Data / Business Intelligence
job_2_desc:
• Global WMS modernization: led up to ~30 engineers across 5 Feature Teams to modernize Decathlon's Warehouse Management System, from a legacy AS400 to a modern platform using the Strangler Pattern.
  • Organization: restructured into autonomous, product-oriented Feature Teams supported by a transverse Ops & QE squad.
  • Quality culture: shifted from traditional QA to Quality Engineering (test automation) and drove performance with DORA metrics.
  • Business Intelligence: previously led a 5-engineer Feature Team on a strategic BI application, combining EM and Tech Lead roles (Java/Spring Boot, Kubernetes, architecture).
  • Teams & AI: built, recruited, and led teams with a focus on trust, ownership, and continuous growth; contributed to the adoption of AI-assisted development practices.
job_3_desc:
• Product & Tech alignment: technical lead of the BI platform, bridging Product and Engineering, and introduced the "3 Amigos" practice.
  • Quality & Performance: major refactoring that doubled calculation and display performance, securing delivery with 80% test coverage.
  • Infrastructure & DevOps: optimized CI/CD pipelines and migrated from Rancher to Kubernetes in close collaboration with Ops teams.
  • Mentorship: mentored developers, raising technical standards and delivery cadence.
job_4_desc: Built backend services and data products, including a sports communities API and a strategic Business Intelligence application, while also facilitating the team as Scrum Master.
job_5_desc: Developed backend applications for major enterprise clients including Nexity, SNCF, and Société Générale, while also acting as Scrum Master.
job_6_desc: Developed backend applications for enterprise clients in the insurance sector.
job_7_desc: Developed full-stack features using PHP/Laravel for a gamification and digital marketing platform.
job_8_desc:
Early professional experience focused on business-oriented engineering and data processing.

  • Data automation: PHP-based tools to automate competitor data retrieval.
  • Analytics: dashboards providing actionable insights to support business decision-making.
pub_1_desc: Multi-objective crypto portfolio optimization using genetic algorithms. Streamlit UI for monitoring.
pub_2_desc: What coming close to burnout taught me about true leadership. Learning to listen to yourself and protect your mental health.
pub_3_desc: How to bring quality back to the core of the product. Moving from a final validation step to collective ownership.
pub_4_desc: Real speed comes from what you build right from day one. Build sustainable products today.
edu_1_desc: Intensive project-based pedagogy (C/C++, software architecture). Fostering strong autonomy and complex problem-solving skills.
edu_2_degree: Master's degree, Computer Science — international year
edu_2_desc: Full immersion. Development of cross-cultural skills and a global perspective on engineering.
